model_output.verdict: A senior backend engineer with substantial payments experience and concrete results, with a few Cobalt Pay requirements unaddressed.
write_up: Your payments work is a strong match for this role! At Lumen Ledger, you connect the services you built and migrations you led to payout volume, downtime and latency. Your earlier freight work adds Java, Kafka and production testing.

The payouts service line is a great model: it names the service, the technologies and the volume it handles. Cobalt Pay also asks for partnership with Finance and Risk on reconciliation and controls, which your resume doesn't show. Your runbooks and incident reviews are relevant, but they don't say whether you carried on-call responsibilities.

Start with the Lumen Ledger reliability work and add your on-call duties if you had them. Add reconciliation, controls or design review leadership if you did that work. Your resume is strong enough that it isn't the main thing standing between you and a callback; the role's requirements and competition matter too.
